text:
Ana: FYI I opened a small docs PR that adds an explicit offline mirror verification step and an example cert-bundle rotation section for private installs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482

Rahul: Thanks. Can you paste the one-liner you added for verifying the mirror GPG fingerprint? We should avoid any dangerous 'apt-key' usage in the guide.

Ana: Good catch. I used the newer approach: 
```bash
# verify key fingerprint
gpg --show-keys --with-fingerprint /mnt/offline-mirror/keys/repo.gpg | grep -E "Key fingerprint"
```
and a note to import via /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/ rather than apt-key.

Jared: Looks safe. Does the PR include a short systemd unit example for the local redwood-agent when customers prefer socket activation? A lot of on-prem folks ask for that.

Ana: Yup, added two variants: socket-activated and plain service. Example in PR: 
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood Agent Socket

[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/redwood-agent.sock
SocketMode=0660

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target
```

Tessa: Small doc nit: the installer example mentions INSTALLER_CERT_CHAIN but the rest of the docs use CERT_CHAIN_PATH. Can we standardize the variable name? I prefer INSTALLER_* for consistency.

Ana: I'll rename to INSTALLER_CERT_CHAIN in the reference table and add an alias note for backward compatibility.

Rahul: Also suggest adding a quick troubleshooting step for private CA bundles failing: show openssl s_client output command and what to look for (certificate chain, SNI).

Ana: added a tiny troubleshooting snippet: 
```bash
openssl s_client -connect registry.example.local:443 -showcerts -servername registry.example.local
# verify chain and the subject CN/SANs
```

Jared: One more: the migration checklist has a step about testing egress via provider NAT. Can we include an outbound check that works behind NAT gateways (DNS+curl) and a note about keeping TCP MSS small for some VPNs?

Ana: added a 2-command check: 
```bash
# DNS and HTTP egress check
curl -sS --fail --max-time 5 https://ifconfig.co && dig +short docs.redwood-inference.internal
```
plus a line about MTU/MSS tweaks for VPNs.

Tessa: Docs lint flagged a broken internal anchor in networking.md (#egress-test vs #egress-tests). I fixed it in my branch, but please run link-checker before merging.

Rahul: One UX suggestion: for the cert rotation section, add a short sample of how to rotate the cert bundle atomically (write new file, move into place, systemctl reload redwood-agent). Many customers botch the permission bits.

Ana: added that exact sequence and a reminder to chown root:root and set 0640.

Jared: LGTM once the variable rename and anchor fix are in. Also please call out the HSM path examples by vendor (YubiHSM, SoftHSM, vendorX) instead of a generic path. I left inline comments on the PR with examples.

Ana: will push updates in ~10m, then trigger a rebuild. If the build passes and there are no broken anchors, can someone approve and merge? I'm out after 5pm.

Tessa: I can merge after lunch if CI is green.
